album_grid_size_desc: Each Telegram album is limited to {{size}} tiles. For example, 10 compatible items at size 7 are sent as two separate grids: 7 + 3.
album_strategy_desc: Define how media queues are partitioned into Telegram collages
album_strategy_smart_adaptive_desc: Photos full 10. Videos auto-clustered into safe 6–8 groups, eliminating server timeout split risks.
album_strategy_safe_balanced_desc: All visual media capped at 6–8 items per collage.
album_strategy_maximum_desc: Maximizes 10 media in front. Prone to 9+1 timeout splits on large videos under server load.
album_strategy_custom_desc: Manually specify maximum collage size via slider.
album_strategy_custom_short_desc: Manually set collage size limit via slider.
album_strategy_smart_desc: System automatically analyzes media types. Photos are grouped up to full 10. Videos are intelligently clustered into safe sets (6–8 items) without lone remainders, eliminating 100% Telegram DC 60s timeout risks, preventing commit failures, and saving massive bandwidth from re-uploads.
album_strategy_smart_short_desc: Photos full 10, Videos safe 6–8 cluster zero timeout.
album_strategy_custom_warning_short: Batch size ≥9 on videos is prone to 60-second server timeouts.
album_strategy_custom_warning_desc: Telegram servers enforce a strict 60-second processing limit per album batch. Uploading 9–10 heavy videos at once frequently exceeds this limit, causing album delivery to fail or break into scattered messages.
album_strategy_custom_warning_example_10: 10 videos: Custom (10) forces 1 large batch prone to timeout failure. Smart mode safely balances it into 5 + 5 (completes in ~12 seconds with unbroken collages).
album_strategy_custom_warning_example_13: 13 videos: Custom (10) partitions into 10 + 3 (batch 10 risks timeout, batch 3 is unbalanced). Smart mode proportionally balances into 7 + 6 (both within the safe 6–8 video zone).
album_strategy_custom_warning_quota_noti: Smart mode guarantees seamless first-pass transfers, saving bandwidth by eliminating re-uploads of large video files.
album_simulator_desc: Simulate how files will be partitioned into collages before uploading to Telegram.
album_incompat_section_desc: Configure how media formats unsupported by Telegram albums are handled when Album mode is active.
album_incompat_image_label: Image Formats (WebP, HEIC, BMP, TIFF, etc.)
media_pillar_image_desc: Configure how non-standard image files outside standard JPG are processed before uploading to Telegram.
image_delivery_strategy_raw: Send 100% Lossless Raw Document (Original Name & Format) [Recommended Safe]
image_delivery_strategy_raw_desc: Files are sent 100% bit-exact (original filename and .png/.webp/.heic format preserved) as uncompressed documents with sharp visual thumbnails in Telegram. Zero loss, zero renaming.
image_delivery_strategy_transcode: Convert / Transcode to Telegram Native Format (Join Album & Chat)
image_delivery_strategy_transcode_desc: Converts selected images into High-Max Quality JPG (Q100 4:4:4) to join Telegram Photo Grid Albums.
media_pillar_anim_desc: Configure how GIF animations or Telegram sticker files are handled during upload.
anim_delivery_strategy_raw_desc: Original .gif animations and .tgs / .webm stickers are sent intact as uncompressed documents with thumbnails.
anim_delivery_strategy_transcode: Transcode to Loop MP4 Video (Join Album & Inline Playable)
anim_delivery_strategy_transcode_desc: Converted into H.264 loop MP4 videos to join native video albums and play inline.
media_pillar_video_desc: Configure whether non-MP4 video containers are remuxed/re-encoded for inline playback or sent as raw documents.
video_delivery_strategy_transcode: Transcode / Remux to Native MP4 (Playable in Telegram) [Recommended]
video_delivery_strategy_transcode_desc: Non-MP4 video containers are converted/remuxed to native H.264 MP4 for inline playback on Telegram Android and Desktop.
video_delivery_strategy_raw: Send as Raw Original Documents (No Transcode)
video_delivery_strategy_raw_desc: Videos are sent in original container format as 100% bit-exact documents with visual thumbnails.
album_media_hub_sync_desc: Handling of image, animation, and video formats is now centrally managed in the Media Delivery Hub without conflicts.
image_transcode_scope_desc: Define which image formats are converted to Max Quality JPG (Q100) to join Telegram grid albums, or sent intact as uncompressed raw documents.
image_transcode_target_png_desc: 100% lossless conversion with zero pixel compression, preserving graphic sharpness and alpha transparency.
image_transcode_target_jpeg_desc: Highest visual quality (Q100) with zero chroma blur for Telegram photo album compatibility.
image_transcode_scope_all: All Non-Standard Formats (.PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, BMP, SVG, PSD, RAW, etc.) [Recommended]
image_transcode_scope_all_desc: All non-standard images are converted to Max Quality JPG (Q100) to join Telegram Photo Grid Albums.
image_transcode_scope_common: Modern Web & Photo Formats Only (.PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, JXL)
image_transcode_scope_common_desc: Only converts modern web/camera formats; heavy graphics and RAW are sent as raw documents.
image_transcode_scope_graphics: Graphics & RAW Formats Only (TIFF, BMP, PSD, SVG, RAW/DNG)
image_transcode_scope_graphics_desc: Only converts graphics and camera RAW files; modern web formats are sent in original format.
image_transcode_scope_custom_desc: Freely choose specifically which image extensions to transcode to JPG or send as raw documents.
image_transcode_scope_none: Send All Non-Standard Images as Raw Documents (No Transcode)
image_transcode_scope_none_desc: No images are converted. All non-standard images are sent 100% lossless as thumbnail documents.

album_failure_retry_prepare_desc: Retry failed preparation, but do not commit a structurally changed group automatically.
album_failure_replan_group_desc: Explicitly allow failed or incompatible items to be removed before repartitioning.
album_failure_send_remaining_desc: Explicitly allow ready items to continue after preparation failures.
album_failure_send_failed_separately_des: Keep the album atomic, then handle proven failed items as separate sends when feasible.

albumAvoidSingle_desc: For example, 11 items become 9+2 instead of 10+1.

groupOriginalDocuments_desc: They remain intact documents and never become visual media.

encoder_resource_balanced_desc: Safe resource limits for normal use.

download_conflict_ask_desc: Request a decision when the destination exists.
download_conflict_rename_desc: Keep both files using a unique name.
download_conflict_overwrite_desc: Replace the destination after safe verification.
download_resume_partial_desc: Use a checkpoint only when source identity and size match.
download_integrity_size_desc: Validate final size for a fast integrity check.
download_integrity_sha256_desc: Validate the full hash for the strongest integrity guarantee.
transfer_profiles_desc: Save and reuse a complete transfer policy. Running jobs retain their frozen snapshot.
delivery_routing_desc: Freeze optional schedule and send-as identity with the album compatibility key.
schedule_at_desc: Leave empty to send immediately. Past or invalid times are ignored safely.
send_as_peer_desc: Telegram must permit the selected account to post as this peer; incompatible items cannot share one album.
spoiler_item_positions_desc: Optional one-based positions for per-item spoilers in the next batch. The global spoiler switch still applies to every item.
alternate_account_pool_desc: Ordered session aliases only. Saved Messages and sessions without verified destination access are rejected.
alternate_identity_approved_desc: Allow these approved sessions to appear as the sender after destination, permission, FloodWait, and runtime limit checks pass.
album_alternate_separate_item_desc: Keep the remaining album on the primary account and send an oversize item separately.
album_alternate_move_whole_group_desc: Require the entire album to pass one alternate account preflight before moving it.
album_alternate_cancel_group_desc: Do not change the album structure or visible sender automatically.
preflight_subtitle: Review the per-item plan before the transfer profile is frozen.
preflight_review_help: Compare detected matches and choose which files should enter the transfer queue.
preflight_duplicate_instruction: Existing Telegram media was found. Review each comparison before queueing.
preflight_all_clean_banner: All files are new and ready to upload to Telegram.
preflight_existing_thumb_stale: Telegram message no longer exists or is inaccessible
preflight_duplicate_reason_exact_sha256: The complete file hash matches the recorded Telegram upload.
preflight_duplicate_reason_probable_file: The filename and byte size match. Review both previews before skipping.
preflight_all_duplicates_skipped: All selected files were skipped. Nothing was added to the transfer queue.
preflight_caption_assignment: The logical album summary is provisionally assigned to item {{index}} and will move to the first surviving item after preparation and duplicate checks.
preflight_safe_rollback: Transfer v4 is disabled operationally. This job will use conservative Grammers single-document delivery without album, oversize routing, or re-encoding; database migrations remain intact.
preflight_album_provisional: Album assignment is provisional until every prepared output, oversize decision, duplicate decision, and send context has been validated.
preflight_more_items: {{count}} more items use the same frozen policy and remain available in Transfer Manager.
preflight_transform_banner_summary: There are {{convertCount}} WebP files that will be automatically converted to PNG (Lossless 1:1) and {{reencodeCount}} video files that will be re-encoded based on active Settings.
preflight_transform_banner_convert: There are {{convertCount}} WebP files that will be automatically converted to PNG (Lossless 1:1) based on active Settings.
preflight_transform_banner_reencode: There are {{reencodeCount}} video files that will be re-encoded based on active Settings.
preflight_info_loc_transform: Menu: Settings ➔ Orchestration ➔ Prevent Converting to Sticker
preflight_info_desc_transform: Converts WebP/stickers to PNG Lossless to send them as a Photo Album.
preflight_info_disable_transform: To disable: Open Settings and uncheck 'Prevent Converting to Sticker'.
preflight_info_desc_clean: All files are confirmed new and have not been uploaded to this topic before.
preflight_info_disable_clean: To configure: Open Settings ➔ Duplicate Engine.
preflight_info_loc_duplicate: Menu: Settings ➔ Duplicate Engine ➔ Duplicate Policy
preflight_info_desc_duplicate: AutoGram matches Message ID, Telegram Unique ID, SHA256 Hash, and Filename+Size to prevent accidental duplicate uploads.
preflight_info_disable_duplicate: To adjust: Open Settings ➔ Duplicate Engine to change default action (Skip vs Force Upload).
preflight_info_desc_rollback: Live MTProto capability detection fell back to standard safe upload engine to ensure maximum transfer reliability.
preflight_info_disable_rollback: To configure: Open Settings ➔ Transfer Engine.
preflight_info_desc_caption: Captions are constrained by Telegram limits (1,024 UTF-16 characters or 2,048 for Premium accounts).
preflight_info_loc_album: Menu: Settings ➔ Orchestration ➔ Group As Album
preflight_info_desc_album: Media items are grouped into 1 Album Grid post (max 10 items).
preflight_info_disable_album: To disable: Open Settings and uncheck 'Group As Album'.
preflight_view_modes_title: View active delivery modes and settings overrides
preflight_modes_engine_desc: Stream pipeline and network mechanism for uploading to Telegram.
preflight_modes_delivery_desc: Media presentation, album grid packaging, and lossless conversion rules.
preflight_modes_storage_desc: Target cloud destination and local disk cache persistence rules.
preflight_modes_duplicate_desc: 4-level verification (SHA256, Message ID, Unique ID, Size).
preflight_filter_empty: No files match the selected filter.
preflight_reason_remote_analysis_deferre: The remote source will be analyzed after it is downloaded locally; it is never guessed to be native media.
preflight_reason_original_generic_docume: ORIGINAL preserves source bytes and uses a GenericDocument payload.
preflight_reason_presentation_forced_doc: Presentation Override explicitly selects a document payload.
preflight_reason_lossless_remux_preferre: An explicit stream map can produce a compatible MP4 without a lossy encode.
preflight_reason_native_video_reencode_p: Native playback requires a validated H.264/AAC output from the selected encoder policy.
preflight_reason_prepared_native_visual: The source is already eligible for a native Telegram media payload.
preflight_reason_prepared_audio_document: Consumer audio uses its own compatible audio group.
preflight_reason_safe_generic_document: A GenericDocument payload preserves the source without unsafe format assumptions.
preflight_warning_remote_analysis_deferr: Remote analysis is deferred until the source exists locally.
preflight_warning_lossy_reencode_planned: A lossy transform is planned and the final output must pass validation.
preflight_warning_preservation_sensitive: Subtitles, multiple audio tracks, attachments, or data streams prevent silent conversion.
preflight_warning_hdr_requires_explicit_: HDR content is preserved as a document until a color policy is explicitly selected.
preflight_warning_native_video_validatio: Native playback compatibility could not be proven; safe document delivery is planned.
preflight_warning_oversize_requires_spli: This item exceeds the effective limit and requires a verified split plan.
preflight_warning_oversize_requires_alte: This item exceeds the effective limit and requires an eligible approved account.
preflight_warning_oversize_requires_skip: This item exceeds the effective limit and will be skipped with an audit record.
preflight_warning_oversize_requires_deci: This item exceeds the effective limit and requires an explicit decision.
preflight_warning_caption_will_truncate: The caption uses {{length}} UTF-16 units and will be safely truncated to the runtime limit of {{limit}}.
preflight_warning_caption_overflow_will_: The caption uses {{length}} UTF-16 units, above the runtime limit of {{limit}}. Change the caption or overflow policy before queueing.
encoder_mode_desc: Select how video files are processed before being delivered to Telegram.
encoder_mode_auto_desc: The system automatically detects and uses the optimal GPU/CPU acceleration.
encoder_mode_hardware_desc: Use a detected hardware GPU for blazing-fast video encoding.
encoder_mode_software_desc: Use pure CPU instructions for maximum encoding stability.
encoder_mode_disable_desc: Deliver videos as-is without re-encoding. Automatic document fallback applies for MKV/AVI/ProRes.
encoder_mode_disable_warning: Video containers (.mkv, .avi, .mov, etc.) will automatically send as documents if Telegram's player doesn't support native streaming.
album_failure_preset_strict_desc: The entire album is cancelled if any single item fails to deliver.
album_failure_preset_best_effort_desc: Successful items are kept and delivered as a resized album.
album_failure_preset_retry_desc: Attempt to repair failed items or send them individually as standard files.
advanced_accordion_desc: Expand to configure album failure policies, delivery schedules, and alternate account pools.
tab_playback_desc: Manage playback resume history and buffer diagnostic preferences for Drive video and audio.
playback_resume_storage_desc: Playback positions are securely stored on your local device per Telegram account and file for 90 days. No URLs, session tokens, or credentials are stored.
playback_telemetry_desc: When playing media in Drive Preview, click the Log button or press shortcut 'L' to open the telemetry overlay. The Traffic Governor monitors buffer runway in real-time to eliminate stutter without triggering Telegram rate limits.
remember_playback_position_desc: Resume Drive audio or video at its last position for this account. Local history expires automatically after 90 days.
playback_history_cache_desc: The last position of Drive audio and video for each account. It stores no URL, token, or local path.
remote_hide_manifests_desc: Hide HLS (.m3u8) and DASH (.mpd) from normal Remote choices. Manifests are inspection-only and are not direct transfer cards.
tab_download_desc: Configure download parallelism, filename conflict policy, and resume reliability.
playback_engine_desc: These settings control GPU/CPU decoder acceleration, frame seeking, and preview loading in AutoGram. They do not change the compression or format of files uploaded to Telegram.
playback_unified_desc: Control GPU acceleration, frame-rate smoothness, and instant preview loading in AutoGram.
playback_auto_desc: Recommended. The system detects the GPU automatically for instant, smooth playback.
playback_gpu_desc: Maximum performance for 4K, HDR, and 120 FPS+ video without CPU fallback.
playback_cpu_desc: Use the system CPU decoder if the GPU has compatibility issues.
playback_fps_mode_adaptive: Adaptive (automatic PTS, source FPS, and display refresh sync)
playback_zerocopy_on: Enabled (direct GPU VRAM, no CPU copy)
playback_advanced_toggle: Show Advanced GPU API & Diagnostic Telemetry Settings
playback_backend_auto: Automatic API (choose the best D3D11VA/NVDEC backend)
playback_diag_on: Show Real-Time GPU Statistics in the Player
duplicate_desc: Configure duplicate detection and duplicate-upload prevention in AutoGram.
dup_skip_desc: Skip files already recorded in history to save time and bandwidth.
dup_force_desc: Always upload a new file without consulting database duplicate history.
dup_level1_desc: Encrypted Telegram Message ID matching in local SQLite database.
dup_level2_desc: Verify official file_unique_id attribute of server Telegram API.
dup_level3_desc: Verify file binary integrity bit-by-bit without misreading.
dup_level4_desc: Precise matching of file names & physical byte size of files.
oversize_desc: Choose what happens when a file exceeds Telegram's 2 GB or Premium 4 GB limit.
oversize_auto_desc: Use Fit-to-Limit for video, splitting for ISO/ZIP, and Premium account routing when available.
oversize_manual_desc: Explicitly choose Split, Fit-to-Limit, Premium account, or Skip.
oversize_approved_desc: Allow the system to use the Telegram Premium account pool without manual confirmation.
unsaved_profile_desc: You have unsaved draft changes. Loading a profile will discard them.
drag_chat_folder_opened: Chat folder opened. Drop on a chat inside it to move the media.
zip_index_explain: AutoGram walks the complete Telegram location and reconciles unique message IDs before enabling ZIP creation. Viewport-only files are never treated as Download All.
zip_index_stalled: The full-location index stopped making progress. Check the Telegram connection, then retry.
zip_pre_resilience_badge: Equipped with Staging Checkpoints & Auto-Resume. Downloads are protected against network drops or rate-limit pauses without restarting from the first file.
zip_floodwait_pause_notice: Telegram FloodWait active: Waiting {{seconds}}s safety cooldown...
zip_staging_skipped_count: {{count}} files already exist in staging checkpoint (skipped)
zip_no_completed_files: No indexed file completed downloading, so the ZIP was not created.
topbar_upload_wait_title: A transfer is still running — stop it in Transfer Manager first
topbar_upload_wait_aria: Upload disabled while a transfer is running
prevent_sticker_conversion_desc: Converts Telegram sticker formats (.webp, .tgs, .webm) into standard photo or video media before uploading to prevent them from becoming stickers in chat.
prevent_sticker_conversion_doc_note: This option is only available in Auto & Native Media Delivery Modes (In Original Document mode, Telegram does not process files as stickers).
storage_info_tooltip_hint: Click or hover to view details
confirm_delete_topic_lead: Topic "{{name}}" and all messages and media within it will be permanently deleted.
confirm_delete_drive_lead: {{count}} Drive(s) and all their contents will be permanently deleted from Telegram.
confirm_delete_drive_lead_single: This Drive and all its contents (folders and files inside) will be permanently deleted from Telegram.
confirm_delete_folder_lead: {{count}} folder(s) will be deleted from Drive along with their contents.
confirm_delete_folder_lead_single: This folder will be deleted from Drive, including all files and subfolders inside.
confirm_delete_file_lead: {{count}} file(s) will be deleted from Telegram.
confirm_delete_file_lead_single: File will be deleted from Telegram (this location).
confirm_reparent_lead: Item will be moved within the Drive tree structure{{detail}}. Files inside the channel are not copied.
confirm_download_lead: {{count}} file(s) will be downloaded to the folder you select.
confirm_download_lead_single: File will be downloaded to your device.
confirm_warn_children_drive: Includes {{count}} folder(s) inside and all media. Cannot be undone.
confirm_warn_children_folder: Includes {{count}} subfolder(s) and all media inside. Cannot be undone.
confirm_warn_all_media_drive: All media in this Drive will also be deleted. Cannot be undone.
confirm_warn_all_media_folder: All media in this folder will also be deleted. Cannot be undone.
confirm_warn_delete_files: This action cannot be undone. Ensure you no longer need these files on Telegram.
confirm_warn_reparent: Only parent= metadata in channel about is updated. Root without parent = Drive; nested = Folder.
confirm_warn_move_mode: Move Mode: source is deleted after successful delivery. Select Copy to retain files at source.
confirm_warn_copy_mode: Copy Mode: source files are kept intact. Forward restricted → auto media copy.
confirm_warn_download: Ensure sufficient storage space and correct destination folder.
confirm_topic_empty: Topic list is empty. Media will be sent to general chat.
index_scope_partial_hint: The durable media/file index is not complete yet. Continue indexing without discarding saved progress.
index_scope_complete_hint: Durable media/file index complete: {{count}} unique items. Link totals are reported separately.
db_error_paused: Database error: indexing paused to preserve data integrity
zip_password_candidates: Passwords found in the Telegram message
zip_password_candidates_hint: Select a candidate to try it. AutoGram does not brute-force passwords.
telegram_access_restricted: This chat is restricted by Telegram for this account.
telegram_access_private: This Telegram chat is private or you no longer have access.
telegram_access_unavailable: This Telegram chat is currently unavailable.
memory_shield_critical_desc: Indexing automatically paused to protect device stability (Heap Usage: {{used}} MB). Click Resume when RAM stabilizes.
lag_shield_aborted_desc: Indexing was instantly aborted due to detected frame lag ({{lagMs}} ms) to ensure your device stays completely responsive and smooth.
tm_pause_move_unavailable: Move/copy jobs can be stopped from the remaining queue.
tm_pause_safe_boundary: Pause safely after the active file finishes; queued files will wait.
tm_pause_single_unavailable: A single active Telegram stream cannot be paused mid-request. Use Stop to cancel it.
tm_pause_queue_empty: No queued files remain to pause.
telegram_restriction_reason_sensitive: This chat is restricted by Telegram due to sensitive content.
telegram_restriction_reason_porn: This chat is restricted by Telegram due to sensitive content.
telegram_restriction_reason_spam: This chat is restricted by Telegram due to spam or abusive activity.
telegram_restriction_reason_copyright: This chat is restricted by Telegram due to a copyright complaint.
telegram_restriction_reason_violence: This chat is restricted by Telegram due to violent or harmful content.
telegram_restriction_reason_restricted: This chat is restricted by Telegram for this account.
remote_native_inspected: The public media inspector traversed {{count}} page(s).
remote_native_interaction_required: No verified public media was found. This page may require JavaScript, sign-in, or a user challenge.
remote_assisted_hint: Complete any challenge yourself; the session is temporary and credentials are never exported.
hide_restricted_media_section_subtitle: Clean restricted media or inaccessible notices from your Drive grid
hide_restricted_media_desc: Automatically filter out and hide Telegram restricted notices ("This channel can't be displayed...") so your Drive explorer stays clean, uncluttered, and free of unopenable items.
drive_engine_file_commit_failed: The upload reached Telegram, but AutoGram could not save its Drive folder mapping. Retry the folder sync.
drive_root_limit_warning: {{count}} root Drives are approaching Telegram's channel limit (~500). Prefer folders inside an existing Drive.
security_danger_executable_desc: This file has an executable binary format ({{format}}), but is named "{{name}}". Do not execute untrusted binaries!
security_mismatch_desc: File named "{{name}}" was detected as true format {{format}} (.{{ext}}).
security_mismatch_info_tooltip: Why did AutoGram detect this extension differently?
security_dialog_title: Why Was an Extension Mismatch Detected?
security_dialog_subtitle: AutoGram binary signature & format intelligence analysis
security_dialog_proof_render_title: Direct Proof: Renders Flawlessly on Canvas
security_dialog_proof_render_body: Chromium / WebView2 on Windows does not support native HEIC decoding out-of-the-box. AutoGram's ability to render this image immediately proves scientifically that the file is authentic JPEG, not HEIC.
security_dialog_proof_absence: This file completely lacks the 'ftypheic' or 'ftypmif1' box signature.
security_dialog_real_cause_title: Why Was This File Detected Differently?
security_dialog_real_cause_desc: This file has a name ending in .{{currentExt}}, but the binary payload inside is actually {{detectedFormat}}. As direct proof, AutoGram's WebView2 browser rendered this image immediately—something impossible for true HEIC files because Chromium on Windows lacks native HEIC decoding.
security_dialog_reason_telegram_desc: Telegram servers automatically transcode mobile photos (like iPhone HEIC) into standard JPEG when sent as standard photos, while keeping original file naming.
security_dialog_reason_tools_desc: Web tools or bots often convert images to standard JPEG for compatibility and bandwidth, but preserve or assign a different file extension.
security_dialog_reason_rename_desc: Files may have had their extension changed manually without re-encoding the actual underlying image data.
security_dialog_safety_desc: This file is completely safe. AutoGram automatically uses the appropriate native engine so you can view it in full quality.
security_missing_ext_desc: Original format detected as {{format}} (.{{ext}}). Adding extension is recommended.
hex_copy_page: Copy hex dump for this page
unsupported_format_desc: Files in {{ext}} format cannot be played or displayed directly in the browser. Download the file to open it with a compatible application.
